name: Archer’s Coup de Grace
body:
You’re an accomplished master of the bow capable of delivering killing shots from a distance.

Prerequisite(s): Far Shot, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot.

Benefit: You may use a bow or crossbow to make coup de grace attempts against helpless opponents within 30 feet.
